summary_1line: Bhishma recounts how the sage Panchasikha instructs King Janaka on the distinction between body and soul and the path to liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: The wandering sage Panchasikha stands in King Janaka’s hall, astonishing a hundred learned teachers while the king bows to hear his doctrine.
Fibers of desire spread through a human body like threads woven by a shuttle, forming the vast wheel of the universe.
A yogin sits in meditation as the sun and moon glow within the firmament of his heart, symbolizing the hidden power of yoga.
